Materials and Methods

The method development and validation experiments were performed using a YMC-Pack ODS-AQ with a column length of 150 mm, an inside diameter of 4.6 mm and a particle size of 3 microns.

Eluent A: 15 mM potassium phosphate dibasic pH 7.2. Eluent B: acetonitrile.

The flow rate was 1.0 mL/min and the column temperature was 29.5 C. Run time was 35 min.

The gradient was 10 to 64% B over 30 min, hold 5 min, return to initial over 1 min.

Results

The PMP-glucose peak had a retention time of 16.7 min.
